name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly after a visit to Sepang International Circuit as a young adult. Captivated by the engineering intricacies, he pursued a degree in aerodynamics and landed an internship with a local racing team. His meticulous approach to data analysis and uncanny ability to spot subtle airflow anomalies quickly made him an invaluable asset. He honed his skills at various teams before joining Proton by Premotion, where he's become known for his innovative wind tunnel strategies.

Ahmad's approach to wind tunnel operation is deeply rooted in a desire to push the boundaries of aerodynamic performance. He believes that true innovation comes from challenging conventional wisdom and constantly seeking new ways to optimize airflow. This visionary outlook, combined with his meticulous attention to detail, has consistently yielded breakthroughs for the team. He's especially focused on developing solutions for low-downforce tracks, an area where he feels Proton by Premotion can gain a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ahmad is of average build with a focused gaze that hints at his analytical mind.
